persistent_identifier_status: Repository-local stable identifier; DOI identifies source article.
title: Paired feed and day-70 digestate macro-nutrient composition in grass–forb/lucerne mono-digestion
citation: Wahid, R., Nielsen, S. F., Hernandez, V. M., Ward, A. J., Gislum, R., Jørgensen, U., Larsen, S. U., & Møller, H. B. (2018). Anaerobic mono-digestion of lucerne, grass and forbs – Influence of species and cutting frequency. Biomass and Bioenergy, 109, 25–31. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.biombioe.2017.12.029
experiment_year: Experiment established in spring 2014; the methods state harvest on 6 October but the excerpted methods do not specify the harvest calendar year.
geography: Foulumgaard Experimental Station, Aarhus University, Denmark
license: Accessible author manuscript at Organic Eprints; no explicit license for the article or data extract was identified in the repository record. Numeric table values are transcribed with source attribution; external redistribution terms should be checked.
material_scope: Pure lucerne silage harvested under a four-cut regime (Lu-4), and multispecies silage mixtures of lucerne, perennial ryegrass, caraway, chicory and ribwort plantain under four-cut (Mix-4) and two-cut (Mix-2) regimes. Not roadside grass and not GreenHub's press cake or isoelectric residual.
experimental_conditions: For continuous AD, the silage was mixed with water at 40:60 mass ratio before feeding. Three 20-L CSTRs had 15-L working volume and were operated at 52 °C for 70 days; effluent was sampled weekly. Table 2 compares feed-mixture concentrations with digestate at day 70. TN and TAN values are reported with standard deviations from duplicate measurements; other macronutrients have no uncertainty reported in the table. Feed/digestate concentrations are not paired flow-weighted inventories.
data_scope: 48 Table 2 entries in long form: TN, TAN, P, K, Mg, Ca, S, and Na for feed mixture and day-70 digestate in Lu-4, Mix-4, and Mix-2. The table's nutrient units/bases are preserved: TN/TAN in percent fresh matter and other elements in g/kg fresh matter. Blank SD means no SD was reported for that cell, not zero uncertainty.
limitations: Reference-only; no GreenHub defaults, canonical parameters, nutrient recovery equations, or route calculations are activated by this extract.
Cultivated Danish forage mixtures include lucerne and forbs, and are not roadside-grass feedstock or the GreenHub post-protein residual stream.
Feed samples are silage mixed with dilution water at 40:60 mass ratio; their wet-basis concentrations must not be compared directly with undiluted grass without accounting for that basis.
Only one CSTR per substrate regime is described; analytical duplicates do not provide process replicate uncertainty.
Feed and day-70 digestate concentrations do not establish nutrient mass retention or recovery without matched flow/stream masses and water balance.
The 2-cut reactor experienced a reported temperature excursion to 65 °C and inoculum addition at day 37; do not interpret all outcomes as steady-state performance.
No alkalinity or full nutrient speciation is reported in this table, and the paper does not quantify nutrient product recovery.
conversion_or_processing: Table 2 means and the reported TN/TAN standard deviations were transcribed as printed. No conversion, concentration-basis harmonization, calculation of removal/recovery, or imputation was performed.
uncertainty: TN/TAN analytical SDs are reported in the table; other analytes have no reported SD. One reactor was used for each substrate regime, and source-specific limits are listed above.
